title: Dark Maximalist Finance Dashboard Landing Page

analysis.title: Dark Maximalist Finance Dashboard Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark landing page centers a tilted, translucent finance dashboard surrounded by floating cards, QR-like graphics, portraits, and decorative symbols. Oversized white typography and vivid yellow accents create a playful, high-energy contrast against the dense layered composition.
analysis.heroPrompt: A cinematic hero visual for a modern finance and lifestyle app: a large translucent glass dashboard window floats at a slight angle in the center, showing abstract charts, transaction rows, colorful category cards, and soft interface glow without readable text. Surround it with scattered rounded utility cards, a tilted black-and-white square code graphic, small circular icons, cropped portrait circles, and a jagged yellow starburst. Use a nearly black textured background, subtle reflections, soft shadows, smoky glass effects, white and yellow highlights, and a dense asymmetric editorial collage. High contrast, premium 3D interface mockup, energetic art direction.
